thread:
Maya Patel: Quick pulse — Echo beta enrollment jumped to 28 active seats overnight, 12 more from the waitlist. Need to triage onboarding bandwidth and a feedback plan.

Jorge Alvarez: Wow, nice. Do we have kickoff calls scheduled for the 12? I've got 2 slots free this week.

Priya Singh: I put tentative 30-min orientations into their calendars (see link). We should also produce a 1-pager for known issues and common FAQs.

Liam Chen: Can someone pull the current activation funnel metrics? I care about first-run success rate + any early intent-to-renew signals.

Maya Patel: @Liam pinged Product for the funnel. For enablement I'm proposing: 1) group webinar next Tue 10am PT, 2) office hours Thu 1–3pm PT, 3) onboarding checklist doc.

Liam Chen: +1 for webinar. I'll prep a 10-min demo + FAQs. Can we surface top 3 integration pain points from CS notes beforehand?

Jorge Alvarez: From my discovery calls: SSO setup, model-pin behavior confusion, and unexpected rate-limit errors. I added notes to the cohort sheet.

Onboard-bot: Reminder — new cohort "Echo" participants added: 12 users. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/beta/echo-onboard

Priya Singh: For the feedback loop: propose NPS at day 7, qualitative interview with 3 customers in week 2, and a short usage survey after 2 weeks. Keeps signal lightweight.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Also flagging a renewal risk — one mid-market customer mentioned a budget review in ~6 weeks. @Jorge can you own that follow-up?

Jorge Alvarez: I'll set a 1:1 and prep a cost/value slide. ETA by EOD Friday.

Liam Chen: I'll create a short bug/feedback template to standardize incoming reports. Paste below:

```
Issue summary:
Steps to reproduce:
Expected behavior:
Actual behavior:
Impact (low/med/high):
```

Maya Patel: Perfect. Also need someone to run an enablement heatmap — which customers need 1:1s vs group resources. @Priya?

Priya Singh: Can do. I'll triage and share a list by tomorrow noon.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Last ask: capture session recordings and anonymize logs before sharing with research. Need a privacy check with Security.

Liam Chen: I'll loop in Sam from eng-security. @Sam Chen — want to chime in on anonymization checklist?

Sam Chen: Sam Chen here — we should strip PII, truncate user IDs, and use hashed identifiers. Store artifacts in the secure bucket: s3://redwood-beta-logs/echo/ and apply the beta-access IAM role.

Maya Patel: I'll assemble a tracker: webinar + office hours + 1:1s + survey + interviews and upload to the cohort board.

Jorge Alvarez: Thanks — I'll follow up on the renewal risk and schedule the calls.

Priya Singh: Shared the triage sheet (view-only): https://sheets.example.com/echo-triage

Maya Patel: Closing loop — webinar scheduled Tue 10am PT, office hours Thu 1–3pm PT. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
